name: NVIDIA GB10 Grace Blackwell (DGX Spark)
memory_bandwidth_basis: vendor spec table value as printed in cited source
notes: DGX Spark superchip: Blackwell GPU + Grace CPU, 128 GB coherent LPDDR5x at 273 GB/s, ConnectX-7, FP4 tensor focus. Direct competitor to Strix Halo at ~4x the price; decode essentially tied with Strix Halo in lhl's gpt-oss-120b sweep while prefill is 2-7x faster.
